Serving Omaha Metro

It’s a classic Omaha scene: the crisp autumn air, the beautiful colors, and then… the endless blanket of leaves covering every square inch of your yard. For a few days, it’s beautiful. Then it becomes a chore, a mess, and a weekend-long project that nobody really wants to do. If you're in a neighborhood with lots of mature trees like Aksarben or Westside, you know exactly what I'm talking about. You spend a whole Saturday raking, and by Sunday morning, it looks like you didn’t even start. My name is Bryan, and I run A1 Junk Removal and Tree Service. We’re not some big, faceless company; we’re a local Omaha business, and we get it. You’ve got better things to do than fight with a rake and a mountain of leaf bags every weekend from October to December. That’s where we come in. We make leaf removal simple, fast, and affordable, so you can actually enjoy your fall.

More Than Just Raking: Why A Wet, Leafy Yard is a Problem

Leaving a thick layer of leaves on your lawn isn’t just an eyesore; it can cause real problems for your grass and soil, especially with Nebraska’s unpredictable weather. When those heavy, wet autumn rains start, a thick mat of leaves can smother your lawn, blocking sunlight and trapping moisture. This creates a perfect breeding ground for mold, fungus, and lawn diseases that can cause dead patches come springtime. It can also make your yard a soggy, muddy mess well into the winter. Plus, let’s be honest, a pile of wet, decomposing leaves is a slip-and-fall waiting to happen. It’s a pain to deal with, and it’s a problem that only gets worse the longer you wait. We don’t just rake; we make sure your lawn can breathe and get the sunlight it needs to survive the winter and thrive next spring.

Our Simple, No-Nonsense Leaf Removal Process

We believe in doing the job right without making it complicated. When you call us for leaf removal, you’re getting a straightforward, efficient service. We’re not just a guy with a rake; we’re a professional crew that has this down to a science. We also handle yard waste removal of all kinds, so if you have fallen branches or other debris, we can take care of that at the same time. Here’s what you can expect when you hire A1 for the job:

Complete Yard Clearing

We use high-powered blowers and good old-fashioned rakes to gather every last leaf from your lawn, flower beds, and walkways.

Bagging or Mulching

We can bag all the leaves for disposal or, if you prefer, mulch them on-site to provide natural nutrients for your lawn and garden beds.

Debris Haul-Away

You won’t be left with a mountain of bags at your curb. We load up everything and haul it away, leaving your property completely clean.

Final Blow-Down

Before we leave, we do a final pass with the blowers on your driveway, sidewalks, and patio to ensure a spotless finish.

Don't Forget the Gutters!

All those leaves from your yard? A good portion of them end up in your gutters. Clogged gutters can lead to serious and expensive problems, like water damage to your roof, foundation issues, and ice dams in the winter. Since we’re already at your property handling the leaves, why not have us take care of your gutter cleaning at the same time? It’s a simple add-on that can save you a major headache down the road. We’ll clear all the leaves and debris from your gutters and downspouts, ensuring water can flow freely away from your home. It’s an essential part of a complete fall cleanup, and bundling services is a great way to save a little money.

Frequently Asked Questions

How much does leaf removal cost in Omaha?

It really depends on the size of your yard and the number of trees you have. A small yard in a newer development might be on the lower end, while a large, tree-filled property in an area like Papillion could be more. We provide free, no-pressure estimates so you know the exact price before we start.

Do I have to be home for the service?

Not at all. As long as we have access to the areas that need clearing, you can go about your day. We’ll get the job done and send you an invoice you can pay online—it’s that easy.

How many times will I need leaf removal in the fall?

For most Omaha homeowners, one or two good cleanups is enough. We often recommend one cleanup mid-season when about half the leaves are down, and a final one after all the trees are bare. This keeps your yard looking good and prevents the lawn from being smothered.

What do you do with all the leaves?

We haul them all away to a proper composting facility. You don’t have to worry about finding space in your trash cans or dealing with dozens of paper bags lining your curb for city pickup. We handle the complete disposal.
